t.zh: 传送带移动了工件，直接比较会把移动也标成变化。夹具已经测出取样偏移，不需要你估计位移。给比较器补上位置对应，再用真正的缺口检验它。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The conveyor moved the item, so direct comparison reports motion as change. A fixture already measured the sampling offset; you do not estimate it. Add correspondence before comparison and test a real defect. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

after.zh:
\[\begin{gathered}S(x,y)=O(x+d_x,y+d_y)\\D(x,y)=|S(x,y)-R(x,y)|\end{gathered}\]

d=(dx,dy) 是给定的读取偏移。先对应同一场景位置，再比较数值，才能减少错位产生的假差异。这里使用已知位移，没有从图像估计未知位移。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[\begin{gathered}S(x,y)=O(x+d_x,y+d_y)\\D(x,y)=|S(x,y)-R(x,y)|\end{gathered}\]

d=(dx,dy) is the supplied read offset. Matching scene positions before comparing values reduces false differences from misalignment. The offset is given, not estimated from the images. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移向量 d = (dx, dy)。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
brief.en: The fixture supplies a sampling offset vector d = (dx, dy). Read the observation at that offset before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.

naiveWhy.zh: 错位让原本相同的结构落在不同位置。调整亮度不能修复位置对应。
naiveWhy.en: Misalignment compares different structures; changing intensity cannot repair correspondence.

hint.zh: d 的分量为正，表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
hint.en: A positive component of d means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

t.zh: 相机只观测了图内的格子，位移取样会碰到缺少的邻居。本任务假设图外读数为 0：这是最简单的约定，不猜测图外有什么。先查看独立示例，区分已有读数与补入的值。
t.en: The camera observed only the cells inside the image, so an offset read meets missing neighbours. This task assumes 0 outside: the simplest convention, guessing nothing about what lies beyond. Inspect the independent example first to tell observed readings from filled-in values.

desc.zh: 按给定偏移向量 d 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
desc.en: Read an observation at an offset vector d and compare with the reference, using zero outside.
